<target>### **3.2.2. Floating-Point Comparison Instructions**

**3.2.2.1.** **`FCMP.cond.{S/D}`**

Instruction formats:

```
fcmp.cond.s    cc, fj, fk
fcmp.cond.d    cc, fj, fk
```

This is a floating-point comparison instruction, which stores the result of the comparison into the specified status code (CC). There are `22` types of cond for this instruction. These comparison conditions and judgment standards are listed in the following table.

_Table 9. Floating-point comparison conditions and judgment standards_

|Mnemoni c|Cond|Meaning|True Conditio n|QNaN Exceptio n|IEEE 754-2008 Funtion|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|CAF|0x0|None|None|No||
|CUN|0x8|Incomparable|UN|No|compareQuietUnordered|
|CEQ|0x4|Equal|EQ|No|compareQuietEqual|
|CUEQ|0xC|Equal or incomparable|UN EQ|No||
|CLT|0x2|Less than|IT|No|compareQuietLess|
|CULT|0xA|Less than or incomparable|UN LT|No|compareQuietLessUnordered|
|CLE|0x6|Less than or equal to|LT EQ|No|compareQuietLessEqual|
|CULE|0xE|Less than or equal to or incomparable|UN LT EQ|No|compareQuietNotGreater|
|CNE|0x10|Vary|GT LT|No||
|COR|0x14|Orderly|GT LT EQ|No||
|CUNE|0x18|Incomparable or unequal|UN GT LT|No|compareSignalingNotEqual|
|SAF|0x1|None|None|Yes||
|SUN|0x9|Is not greater than or equal to|UN|Yes||
|SEQ|0x5|equal|EQ|Yes|compareSignalingEqual|
|SUEQ|0xD|Not greater than or less than|UN EQ|Yes||
|SLT|0x3|Less than|IT|Yes|compareSignalingLess|
|SULT|0xB|Is not greater than or equal to|UN LT|Yes|compareSignalingLessUnordered|
|SLE|0x7|Less than or equal to|IT EQ|Yes|compareSignalingLessEqual|
|SULE|0xF|Not greater than|UN LT EQ|Yes|compareSignalingNotGreater|
|SNE|0x11|Vary|GT LT|Yes||
|SOR|0x15|Orderly|GT LT EQ|Yes||
|SUNE:|0x19|Incomparable or unequal|UN GT LT|Yes||

Note: `UN` means no comparison, `EQ` means equal, `IT` means less than. When there is at least one `NaN` in two operands, the two numbers cannot be compared.</target>
